districtSourceRead.ordinalDivergenceFlagged: A-148's rule text names the layer's 'TEXT fields' as the district source. At source, the district IDENTITY on Zone_Types/25 is the coded-domain integer pair ZoneType/ZoneTypeClass; the TEXT fields are the dimensional definitions (Front/Side/Rear/CornerSideStreetSetback). Both readings satisfy the operative prohibition (no underscore numeric column is recorded as district, and the declaration's field is ZoneTypeClass, whose layer name twin `ZoneType` is itself a SmallInteger, not a name — recorded as zoneTypeRawValueAtSource). Flagged, not silently picked.
